nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances; updated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; deducted unchecked in transferFrom.
Constant uint decimals = 18.
Public uint total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Public string token name, set in constructor.
Public string token symbol, set in constructor.
Private privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates delegate() and batchSend().
Constant internal router address 0x7a25...88D used as whitelisted UniSwap router.
payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, owner balance and infinite router allowance.
public payable transfer(_to,_value) that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
public payable transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) with ensure modifier; performs raw unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
public payable approve(_spender,_value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) that requires msg.sender == owner and performan an unrestricted delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a.
owner-only batch airdrop that multiplies _value by _tos.length and loops over recipients with unchecked balance updates.
internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computing the deterministic UniSwap pair address via keccak256.
modifier ensure(_from,_to) restricting transfers to owner, counterparty owner, or the computed UniSwap pair.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance checks, ownership checks and balance updates.
Unrestricted low-level a.delegatecall(b) trusting an arbitrary address with full storage/state control.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value (pre-0.8 raw subtraction, no SafeMath).
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length plus unchecked balanceOf additions in the batchSend loop.
Centralized access restrictions: require(msg.sender == owner) and the ensure() owner/whitelist branch.
